purpose: Machine-readable rules for generating a complete multi-sensor display system and installing offline sandboxed renderer or chart surfaces without changing Shroom's permanent backend pipeline.

normativeLanguage.MUST: required; failure stops generation or installation
normativeLanguage.MAY: optional only when all MUST rules remain satisfied

requiredReadOrder.responseShape: raw contract object; this endpoint is not wrapped in HttpResult and has no data prefix
requiredReadOrder.rule: MUST read the live SDK contract before selecting routes, schemas, protocol presets, channels, or built-in renderers. Do not rely on remembered values.
MUST read the installed policy and stop when its schemaVersion or required capabilities are unsupported.
MUST inspect installed app ids before installation. Existing apps are not overwritten by default.

changeBoundary.rule: A display app is installed as local data files through the public API. It MUST NOT patch application source or create a second acquisition pipeline.
forbiddenActions: modify the Electron bridge, preload, IPC, backend, SDK contract, serial lifecycle, parser, storage, playback, CSV, or WebSocket gateway
write directly into build, asar, application installation, database, or runtime internal directories
open a serial port, SQLite database, raw WebSocket, shell, child process, or Electron IPC from renderer code
create a second protocol catalog, frame envelope, storage format, replay path, or CSV path

allowedKinds.idRule: Use an exact renderer id returned by the live SDK contract or platform catalog. MUST NOT guess or hardcode an unavailable built-in id.
The platform creates this stable rendererId after the app is installed; appId is manifest.id.

rendererSelection.customRendererWhen: Use an agent renderer when the user independently chooses a new renderer, or agrees to one because no compatible built-in exists.

chartSelection.builtIn: Use a catalog-advertised formula chart when one scalar history expresses the request.

agent.rule: Use a chart id returned by GET /api/agent-apps only. The host mounts it in the existing sidebar chart area and supplies the same sanitized sensor frame contract.

chartSelection.customChartWhen: Use an Agent chart for XY trajectories, multiple synchronized series, or another chart shape the live formula catalog cannot express.

appManifest.surfaceRule: At least one renderer or charts[] entry is required. Renderer-only, chart-only, and combined packages are valid.

entry.rule: MUST be a portable relative path present in install.files; no traversal, absolute path, URL, or backslash alias.
MUST be a portable relative path present in install.files; no traversal, absolute path, URL, or backslash alias.

permissions.rule: Permissions are host capabilities, not browser APIs. sensor.read only supplies sanitized init/frame messages. An explicitly empty array is invalid.

httpEnvelope.transportExceptions: Malformed JSON and a request body larger than the host-wide 50 MiB parser limit are rejected before the Agent Apps route and may use the host's legacy raw {error} transport response. Treat any non-2xx response as failure before reading HttpResult fields.

rules: manifest is the parsed app.json and MUST NOT also be supplied as files/app.json
every declared renderer/chart entry MUST exist in files
encoding MUST be utf8 or base64
overwrite MUST remain false unless the user explicitly authorizes replacement of that exact app id
all files and dependencies MUST be packaged locally; network URLs and runtime downloads are forbidden
browser installation requests MUST originate from a loopback page; a native local Agent or CLI may omit Origin

staticFile.response: raw local file with a safe content type
staticFile.rule: Renderer files are served only from the installed app directory after path validation.

sandbox.iframeRule: The host runs Agent renderer and chart HTML in a sandbox. Every surface MUST accept data only when event.source === window.parent.
sandbox.originModel: The iframe has an opaque origin. Static app responses use Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: cross-origin so package files can load; isolation relies on sandbox flags, exact app-files CSP, path validation, and the postMessage source check rather than same-origin trust.

securityBoundary.purpose: capability isolation for trusted packaged renderer code
notGuaranteed: absolute CPU or memory denial-of-service protection
securityBoundary.reviewRequirement: Renderer source and packaged assets MUST be reviewed before installation. Do not install intentionally hostile, obfuscated, or resource-exhausting code.

sandbox.samePackageResourceAccess: MAY use fetch only for a relative file inside the current installed app when the live policy/host advertises the exact /api/agent-apps/:id/files/ prefix. This is local package access, not network authority.
sandbox.contentSecurityPolicyAuthority: The host's dynamic HTTP response header is authoritative. Renderer files MUST NOT try to weaken or replace it; an HTML meta CSP is neither required nor sufficient and can accidentally block opaque-origin package assets.

requiredHostContentSecurityPolicy.script-src: the exact current-app /api/agent-apps/:id/files/ prefix; inline script is forbidden

connect-src.allowedException: the exact current-app /api/agent-apps/:id/files/ prefix advertised by the live host

forbiddenApis: fetch or XMLHttpRequest to any URL outside the exact host-provided current-app static resource prefix

payloadFields.serial: read-only sanitized object declared by serialMetadata|null
payloadFields.channels: optional array of channel items declared by multiChannelExtension

multiChannelExtension.compatibility: The top-level frame payload remains the current widget route. A host may additionally include channels; a missing channels field is a valid single-channel v1 message.

itemFields.serial: read-only sanitized object declared by serialMetadata|null

rules: Every item MUST have a canonical identity and state MUST be keyed by full channelId.
The renderer MAY combine channels for one visualization but MUST NOT infer roles from array order.
The top-level current route remains available and MUST continue to work when channels is absent.
The host rebuilds every payload from a whitelist and sends JSON-safe data only.
The renderer MUST reject unsupported schemaVersion values.
init MUST be accepted before frame, MUST be idempotent, and the renderer SHOULD emit ready after every valid init so a lost startup ready can recover.
frame.channelId MUST equal the initialized channelId.
channelId MUST equal displaySystemId + ':' + sensorId.
The renderer MUST NOT mutate, reinterpret, or send sensor data back to the host.
serial is optional, read-only diagnostic metadata and may change after reconnect
serial MUST NOT contain handles, functions, parser objects, Electron objects, or unlisted properties
serial role, portId, path, parserChannel, status, and array position MUST NOT define or infer business identity
left/right/backrest/seat identity remains the explicit sensorId, sensorLabel, outputChannel, and canonical channelId

sensorData.sensorLabelSource: The host-provided sensorLabel, originating from the matching sensors[].label; fallback is sensorId.
sensorData.businessRoleRule: MUST NOT infer left hand, right hand, backrest, seat, or another role from serial role, portId, COM path, parserChannel, port order, protocol id, output arrival order, or array index.
sensorData.canonicalValuesSource: sensor.frame.payload.value projected by the host as frame.payload.values and, when present, frame.payload.channels[].values
sensorData.legacyRule: MUST NOT read, generate, or depend on top-level sitData/backData/headData. They are input-only aliases inside the platform compatibility boundary.
sensorData.multiSensorRule: Keep state keyed by full channelId. Frames from different sensors or reconnect order MUST NOT overwrite each other; channels array position has no identity meaning.

displaySystemGeneration.purpose: Generate a complete schema-v3 display system whose protocol, per-sensor mapping, algorithm, renderer, widgets, charts, realtime, storage, playback, and CSV all remain on the permanent platform pipeline.

requiredDiscovery.requiredData: catalog including supported renderers, layoutPresentations, algorithms, chart templates, serial templates, limits, and writable capabilities
the live protocol preset catalog; do not maintain a second list
existing display-system ids and runtime status

sensorRules: sensors MUST be a non-empty array and every id MUST be explicit, stable, unique, trimmed, and contain no colon
label is the business sensorLabel and MUST be explicit; never derive it from COM, protocol, or position
outputChannel MUST be explicit, non-empty, trimmed, and unique across sensors
stored MUST be explicit; false means realtime only and true enables the existing storage/replay/CSV path
matrix is display geometry and MUST NOT rewrite protocol.decoding.valueCount or a fixed protocol.framing.frameLength
files MUST point to that sensor's definitions; multi-sensor systems SHOULD use <sensorId>/ subdirectories
protocol MUST be the complete normalized selected/detected preset rather than a partial UI projection
algorithm MUST select an existing pipeline mode; arbitrary code follows algorithmPolicy

<sensorId>.lineOrder: object or array for this sensor only
<sensorId>.algorithmSource: string|null; copy registered compatible package source, or supply new algorithm code only with explicit authorization

rules: definitions.sensors keys MUST exactly match manifest sensors[].id
Each route keeps its own line order, point order, coordinate map, algorithm data, and authorized algorithm source
Do not place only the first sensor's definition at the top level and project it over other sensors
Line order, geometry transform, and algorithm execute once in the existing backend pipeline

lineOrder.order[i] is a one-based input index for output position i; pointOrder.points[i] uses zero-based [row, col]. Convert a documented complete 0..N-1 permutation by adding one once at import; keep a complete 1..N permutation unchanged. For subsets, placeholder zeros, missing points or ambiguous mapping direction, verify semantics instead of guessing the base. Test output[i] equals input[order[i]-1] with distinguishable samples and then verify point placement; length and uniqueness alone do not establish correctness.

protocolSelection.presetFirstRule: Before constructing a protocol from prose, compare the document with every live preset. If exactly one preset matches baud rate, delimiter/header bytes, decoded value type/count, and byte width, MUST copy its complete protocol object.
protocolSelection.wireDocumentRule: A documented frame header plus payload plus total frame length describes the wire layout and MUST NOT by itself select fixedLength. Shroom fixedLength cuts from the current stream position and does not search for the header.
protocolSelection.delimiterRule: When a matching preset uses the documented header as delimiter with includeDelimiter false, decoding starts at payload byteOffset 0; do not duplicate delimiter bytes as validation or decoding offset.
protocolSelection.ambiguityRule: If no preset matches and header/delimiter/start/end semantics are ambiguous, use live detection or request evidence. Never infer fixedLength only from total frame length.

request.candidateIds: optional ids from the live preset catalog

rules: Only matched may populate the current sensor protocol, and it MUST copy the complete returned protocol
ambiguous and unknown preserve the draft and require manual selection or more evidence
Detection identifies a wire protocol only; it MUST NOT assign left/right/backrest/seat or another business identity
The temporary COM path is not saved into the display-system manifest
Explicit protocol.decoding.valueCount and fixed protocol.framing.frameLength MUST survive save unchanged even when matrix or point count differs

algorithmSelection.requestedOutputRule: Requested indicators and charts are algorithm metric requirements. Before choosing algorithm none, match user intent against live package names, descriptions, compatibility, and metricDefinitions.

metricIntentExamples.respirationWaveformOrTrend: 普通呼吸趋势将算法每次输出的单值按时间入队；只有明确要求呼吸波形时才必须有呼吸信号指标。呼吸率队列准确标为呼吸率趋势（次/分），不能用压力替代。
metricIntentExamples.centerOfPressureTrajectory: paired center-of-pressure X and Y metrics

algorithmSelection.registeredPackageRule: Unless the user explicitly chooses a new algorithm, if one compatible registered package supplies the requested metrics, MUST attach it even when the user did not name its internal package id.
algorithmSelection.fallbackRule: 呼吸数据只能来自所选内置或 Agent 算法包的明确呼吸输出。禁止用总压力、平均压力、滤波压力或去基线趋势替代；加代理标签或移入 Python 包也不能豁免。普通呼吸趋势可用算法呼吸率单值队列；仅在明确要求波形却无对应信号时报告缺口，不能混淆名称。其他展示估算仍需明确授权、代理标识，且不得替代所选包已有指标。
algorithmSelection.metricQueueRule: 算法每次返回一个数即可由图表按时间组成有界队列，不要求算法返回整段波形。按 channelId 和指标隔离，切换清空，去重帧时间戳而非相同数值。按算法契约排除无效标记、缺失和非有限值，缺口断线、恢复重新成段；不补零、不用压力补位。队列属于展示缓存而非新增测量算法。
algorithmSelection.respirationSourceRule: 核对算法包版本、真实输出和指标含义，不仅匹配 respirationSignal 等名称。未支持、预热、失败、缺失和过期分别展示真实状态；清除当前读数并中断曲线，不能补零、复用旧值或生成压力代理。新建呼吸算法须按算法扩展授权运行；用户另行请求的压力趋势是独立图表，不能计作呼吸功能。
algorithmSelection.metricSemanticsRule: For every indicator chart, record package/version, source metric, meaning, unit or unitless status, validity conditions, and proxy status. Proxy semantics MUST be disclosed even when computed inside a Python package. Signed baseline-removed respiration waveform is distinct from nonnegative valid respiration rate in breaths/minute; MUST NOT rectify, clamp, or shift a waveform merely to hide its sign. Missing, warming-up, failed, or stale metrics MUST show their actual state, not fabricated zeros or unlabelled pressure-change estimates. Center-of-pressure charts MUST state coordinate range/direction and show no valid center when effective pressure is absent.

componentChoice.rule: 用户只需描述效果并提供资料。未指定来源时，Agent 自动复用当前兼容能力，用一句普通话说明后继续，不要求先选择自带/新建或提供内部标识。尊重算法、渲染器、图表各自的明确选择；新建某一项不替换另外两项。
componentChoice.clarificationRule: 仅追问影响正确性的缺失事实或所需新授权：附件冲突、多个物理设备的业务对应、打开硬件所需 COM、改变指标含义或新增算法/依赖、替换指定渲染效果。没有 COM 可先生成配置，不猜端口或打断当前系统。
componentChoice.chartImplementationRule: 请求图表已包含在公开扩展内实现该图形的授权。没有可用模板或已核实兼容的图表时，可创建仅图表应用并消费已有算法指标；不需要用户先指定 iframe 或注册方式。用户明确要求只用自带时报告缺口，不自动新建。不得因此替换主渲染器、算法或宿主外壳。

ordinaryRequestDefaults.respirationChart: 默认将兼容注册算法的呼吸单值按时间组成队列绘图，不只显示一个数字。呼吸率输出画呼吸率趋势（次/分），呼吸信号输出画信号曲线；明确请求波形时才要求波形指标，禁止压力趋势冒充。
ordinaryRequestDefaults.centerOfPressureChart: 默认压力重心 XY 轨迹和当前位置，来源为算法成对坐标；缺失和无有效压力时不伪造原点。
ordinaryRequestDefaults.presentation: 默认沿用平台统一深色宿主、铺满顶栏下工作区并保留图表浮层；不需要用户补充手部监测、布局字段或隐藏描述带。仅使用当前目录实际公开的能力。

display.rawValuesRule: matrix.total constrains values only. rawValues is an optional independently sized decoded-stage array; never enforce equal matrix length, truncate, pad or substitute processed values. Validate each channels[] item against its own matrix. Charts consume algorithmMetrics when available.
display.widgetSourceRule: Every data widget in a multi-sensor system MUST explicitly set source to that sensor's exact outputChannel. New manifests SHOULD use outputChannel itself, not a *Data suffix or array position.
display.rendererRule: Resolve natural-language intent against live renderer ids and labels. When an exact compatible renderer is advertised, MUST use it by default; creating a new display system does not authorize a new renderer.

rendererIntentExamples.3dPointPlot: 3D point plot, 3D point grid, 3D 点图, and 3D 点阵 select the live point-grid renderer (currently pointGrid when advertised).

display.customRendererWhen: Use agent:<appId> when the user independently chooses a new/custom renderer, or agrees to one because no compatible built-in exists. A choice to create a chart or algorithm does not authorize replacing the renderer.
display.nativePointRendererRule: Adding respiration or center-of-pressure charts does not authorize replacing the main renderer. MUST NOT substitute Canvas 2D perspective projection, wireframe mesh, or another imitation for a requested native 3D point renderer. If the native renderer is incompatible, report the gap and obtain explicit agreement before substituting a different presentation. Verify the actually mounted renderer, not only its dropdown label.
display.profileRule: Every profile renderer reference and widget id MUST resolve to a declared renderer/widget.
display.layoutPresentationRule: Main rendering MUST fill the application workspace below the permanent top bar. Default display.layout.presentation to workspace with retained collapsible chart overlays when advertised. Distinguish this from OS fullscreen and immersive (hidden charts). Do not implement fullscreen with fixed iframe heights. Unsupported hosts must report the layout capability gap.
display.workspaceWithChartsRule: When the user requests workspace fill like hand monitoring while retaining charts, MUST preserve requested charts as host-owned collapsible overlays below the permanent top bar. Select display.layout.presentation workspace only when catalog.layoutPresentations advertises workspace with retainsCharts true and collapsibleCharts true. The immersive mode covers the standard sidebar and alone does not meet this combined requirement. If unsupported, report the specific host capability gap and need for separately authorized host changes; MUST NOT invent manifest fields, patch protected source, or recreate the application shell in an Agent renderer.
display.canvasSizingRule: The main canvas MUST fit available host space, not simulate fullscreen with a fixed large height such as 1080px. CSS layout dimensions and backing-store pixel dimensions MUST be independent; backing-store updates MUST NOT grow the parent in a resize feedback loop. Update dimensions only when measured target size changes. Main canvas MUST NOT produce overflow scrollbars; chart sidebar may scroll independently. Verify stability during continuous rendering, window resizing, and system switches.
display.runtimePresentationRule: Keep display.controls.runtimeChrome absent or false for a clean hand-monitor-aligned runtime canvas. Set it true only when the user explicitly requests on-canvas diagnostic/profile controls. Custom renderer roots stay transparent and MUST NOT add title, description, id, baud-rate, or selector bands around the plot.

charts.builtin: Use catalog-advertised chartCards/templates and supported formula syntax; at most the live catalog limit.
charts.agent: An Agent renderer remains one main-canvas visualization. Custom chart code MUST be declared in app.json charts[] and referenced by display.chartCards[].agentChartId; the host mounts it in the existing sidebar chart area. Do not embed sidebar charts in the main renderer.
charts.metricRule: 图表只消费所选算法包的对应指标。呼吸缺少算法输出时显示未支持/等待/失败/过期并停止曲线，禁止压力趋势替代。不得把算法包内计算的压力代理冒充呼吸；其他展示估算需要明确授权与代理标识。
charts.surfaceRule: A custom chart iframe draws only its plot body on a transparent root. It MUST NOT recreate the host card background, title, delete control, summary block, or sidebar spacing.
charts.dataRule: Chart rendering does not create another storage or analysis truth; persisted/exported values remain those from the permanent pipeline.

rules: overwrite MUST remain false unless the user explicitly authorizes replacing this exact display-system id
On conflict, choose another id or stop; do not retry silently with overwrite true
After save, call the contract-advertised reload route and read the editor/detail response to verify every sensor round-tripped independently

activation.purpose: A saved display system receives no data until it is the active sensor type and its serial roles are open. Saving alone is not installation.

switchCommand.rule: sensorType MUST equal the first sensor's exact type; it is the activation key shared by every channel of the system

serialOpenCommand.rule: role MUST be the sensor id (platform serialRole), never outputChannel or a legacy alias; undeclared roles are rejected with INVALID_COMMAND before any hardware action

verification: GET /api/display-systems -> runtimeBindings.bindings for this system MUST all be status bound with no error
GET /api/serial/status MUST list every opened role
When a physical COM was supplied, observe at least one real canonical sensor.frame per opened sensor with matching identity and the expected mapped value count
rules: After save/reload, activate and open hardware only when the intended device and COM mapping are explicit and the user has authorized the connection. Missing COM does not block preparing a draft; ask at the hardware step, never guess a port or interrupt an existing running system for a preview. Do not claim end-to-end success without hardware verification.
bound plus open is control-plane evidence only and MUST NOT be reported as successful framing
Synthetic frames do not satisfy hardware verification. If no valid real frame arrives within a bounded window, report configured but not hardware-verified and retain parser diagnostics
LICENSE_REQUIRED (403) on either command MUST stop generation and be reported; the Agent MUST NOT attempt to bypass licensing

acceptance: Every configured sensor has a distinct canonical channelId, visible sensorLabel, explicit widget source, and its own geometry/definitions
The system is the active sensor type, every runtime binding is bound, and every declared serial role is open
Every supplied physical serial route produced a real canonical sensor.frame with matching identity and expected mapped value count; open status alone is insufficient
Protocol valueCount, fixed frameLength, includeDelimiter, headerOffset, checksum offset, and explicit checksum range round-trip unchanged
Realtime values, stored data, replay values, and CSV realData match per canonical channelId for stored:true sensors
stored:false sensors publish realtime but do not appear in storage, replay, or CSV
Multi-rate playback uses platform alignment and renderer state never depends on channels array order
Actually mounted renderer id and implementation match the requested native point renderer; labels alone are insufficient
Real data reaches the main canvas and indicator charts from the intended canonical route with consistent timestamps and metric provenance
Requested workspace layout preserves visibility and interaction of the permanent top bar and requested charts
Continuous rendering, repeated window resizing, and system switches leave stable canvas dimensions without growth loops or main-canvas overflow
Chart titles, units, signed-waveform semantics, proxy labels, and missing/warming-up/failed/stale states match the algorithm contract

Record pass, fail, or not verified with evidence for every acceptance item; distinguish fresh test-page evidence from the user's existing desktop window. Save success, renderer ready, and open serial status alone do not prove delivery. MUST NOT claim complete delivery while a required item fails or remains unverified
No permanent backend, contract, database, WebSocket, playback, or CSV implementation was modified

allowedWithoutAdditionalAuthorization: an algorithm or declarative operation already exposed by the live platform contract and executed in the existing pipeline
explicitAuthorizationRequired: new executable, WASM, native library, DLL, shell command, package, or runtime dependency

multiSensorRules: input.sensors MUST contain stable manifest sensor ids
input.triggerSensor MUST be one of input.sensors
the package MUST be attached only to its trigger sensor
request.frames is keyed by sensor id after protocol decode and line/point mapping
strict is software timestamp validation and MUST NOT be described as hardware synchronization

rules: Renderer HTML is presentation-only and MUST NOT implement an alternate acquisition, calibration, storage, replay, or CSV algorithm.
Authorized JavaScript or Python algorithms MUST run through the existing platform algorithm host and permanent frame pipeline, with its validation and timeout controls.
If explicit authorization is absent, stop or use an existing declared algorithm; never silently embed code in the renderer.

overwritePolicy.rule: MUST list installed apps first. Replacing an existing id requires explicit user authorization naming that id; otherwise choose a new id or stop.

requiredChecks: GET /api/sdk/contract succeeds and required contract versions are supported
app.json and policy.json parse as strict JSON
manifest id and renderer id satisfy the exact safe-kebab pattern
renderer.entry and every referenced local script or asset are each included once in files; every path is local, portable, relative, and within limits

The host response has the required restrictive CSP; renderer HTML does not add a conflicting meta CSP, contains no external URL, and any optional fetch is restricted to the exact current-app static resource prefix
renderer accepts init idempotently, replies ready after each valid init, then renders frame.payload.values and safely keys optional frame.payload.channels by full channelId
renderer reports invalid messages with shroom.renderer.error and does not render them
canonical channelId and sensorLabel remain visible and frames from another channel are rejected
installation uses overwrite:false unless exact replacement was explicitly authorized
the permanent backend and stable contract have no source changes
